sentences.text: 4. Bailable warrants were issued against the revisionist vide order dated 16.4.2024.

Office vide its report dated 21.5.2024 and 02.07.2024 reported that as per report received from the Chief Judicial Magistrate concerned, the revisionist has died on 05.10.2021, the said report is on record.
Perusal of the same goes to show that the revisionist has died and in support of which a report of Gram Pradhan and photocopy of death certificate have been annexed.
The statements of Sub Inspector Nanhe Lal Singh, P.S. Aata, District Jalaun and Gram Pradhan Lallu Kanjar and the son of the revisionist have been recorded.
6. The trial court records, if received, be sent back along with the communication of this order.
Office to communicate this order to District and Sessions Judge concerned within two weeks from today for information and follow-up action.

(Samit Gopal,J.) Order Date :- 3.7.2024 #Naresh#
